responsibility: Implements GCC’s generic in-memory graph data-structure utilities used by analyses that need explicit vertices and edges independent of CFG-specific types. It owns graph allocation on an obstack, edge insertion and vertex merging, textual dumping, depth-first search with optional subgraph and edge-skipping callbacks, strongly connected component computation via Kosaraju’s algorithm, generic edge iteration, and dominator-tree construction over the graph representation.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the graphds group's generic graph library: it allocates graphs, mutates edges/vertices, and runs DFS, SCC, and dominator-tree algorithms. Unlike graphds.h, which declares the graph/vertex/edge structures and APIs, this file provides the algorithmic and storage behavior; unlike graph.cc, it is not CFG DOT dumping code.
